# Public search image fixture

`photosynthesis.png` is an unmodified thumbnail of **Photosynthesis_en.svg** by At09kg (original), Wattcle (vector graphics) and Nefronus (revised vector graphics), licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). [Original and full attribution](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Photosynthesis_en.svg).

Retrieved through the live Wikipedia PageImages API on 9 November 2026 (Asia/Manila). Tests serve this checked-in image at its public thumbnail URL to make UI captures deterministic. Synthetic account data and controlled search responses do not establish live identity matching or provider quality. The live API probe is recorded separately in the release validation.
